reverifications.original_claim: assess_marriage returns an empty `seventh_lord_placement` field (reported by the PRIOR, non-PARIPURNA-2 audit).
reverifications.evidence: The identifier `seventh_lord_placement` does not exist anywhere. (a) Repo-wide grep (excluding .git/node_modules, INCLUDING all 495 pp2-audit/evidence captures): ZERO matches. The only near-neighbour is `seventh_lord`, which exists solely inside bo_upaya.py's maraka-verdict helper (lines 719/764/766/783/790) and its unit test — a different subsystem, never serialized to any assess_* response. (b) Fresh live call to assess_marriage(chart_id=482012f1-...) this pass returned 158,200 bytes; its content object has exactly 21 keys — domain, domain_label, chart_id, ayanamsha_id, ranking_basis, verdict, reading_checklist, verdict_skeleton, step_results, house_analysis, karaka_analysis, varga_analysis, sensitive_degree_firings, kp_cusp_chain, gochara_sweep, activating_dasha, contradictions, yoga_fact_ids, citations, judgment_flags, provenance — and no field of that name at any nesting depth (grep of the unwrapped response: 0 hits). A field that has never existed cannot be 'empty'. AUDIT-INTEGRITY DATA POINT: the prior audit asserted a named response field, with a stated value-state, for a field the codebase has never defined. This is a fabricated observation, not a mis-graded one — the claim is not merely wrong about severity or root cause, it names a non-existent artifact. It should be treated as evidence that the prior audit's findings were, at least in part, generated rather than measured, and no unre-verified prior-audit finding should be inherited into PARIPURNA-2's manifest on its own authority. IMPORTANT COUNTERWEIGHT — the underlying concern the claim gestures at is REAL and independently confirmed by this audit's own live measurement (F-113): natal D1 dignity-in-bhava for the 7th house is in no leg of assess_marriage's pipeline. Saturn is EXALTED in Libra in the 7th house (2nd-strongest graha in this chart) and Venus is the 7th lord in the bottom strength quartile; the string 'exalted' appears ZERO times in the whole 158,200-byte response (re-verified live this pass, grep -ic = 0), and '7th lord' appears exactly once. So: the SPECIFIC claim is fabricated; the DEFECT CLASS it points at is real, already independently found and measured by this audit as F-113, and is not weakened by the prior claim's unreliability.

reverifications.notes: Graded FABRICATED-BY-PRIOR-AUDIT on the claim as literally stated. Do NOT read this as 'assess_marriage is fine' — it is not (F-15, F-111, F-113, F-114 all reconfirmed live in the same call). Recommend the orchestrating session record a standing rule: prior-audit findings enter the manifest only after independent live reproduction.

The PR exists, is correctly titled, and is UNMERGED. (c) `git merge-base --is-ancestor 525188467 HEAD` => NOT ancestor: the fix commit still is not on this branch. (d) The root data condition is also untouched: SELECT count(*) FROM brahma_prospective_ledger WHERE chart_id=482012f1... AND isempty(observation_window) => 4 rows, exactly the 4 F-01 named. Any remediation-tracking that counts authored PRs as closed findings will systematically overstate completion.
